mentions.name: KatipoBrowser
mentions.description: A music player entering open beta after about a year of development. It is built on the author's own programming language, engine, and network protocol so it syncs wirelessly, and was developed without AI.
mentions.source_excerpt: I am releasing my music player into open beta this week! I’ve been working on it for a year or so, created my own language, engine, and network protocol to make it all sync wirelessly, and with no AI :) https://github.com/mjdave/katipoBrowser
